What Makes Us The Right Website Development Agency

Hiring the best web developer shouldn’t mean hoping for the best. We check these six lines on every WordPress website and Shopify store we build, whatever the budget, before anything goes live.

  • SpeedImages, code, fonts and caching tuned until pages feel instant on a mid-range phone, not just on our desktop.Core Web Vitals: pass
  • Mobile-first designLaid out for thumbs first, then scaled up for tablets and desktops, and tested on real devices.360px and up
  • SEO foundationsClean headings, schema markup, an XML sitemap, metadata and internal links, all set up before launch.Schema + sitemap
  • Built to convertEvery page has one job and one clear call to action. Forms and checkout are tested end to end.1 goal per page
  • Safe migrationsMoving from Wix, Squarespace, WooCommerce or an old theme? Your products, customers, orders and URLs come with you.301 for every old URL
  • Care after launchUpdates, backups and security checks keep your WordPress website or Shopify store healthy while you run the business.Backups + updates
